reviews.reason: Checked all five objective definitions, positive scaling of the Lasso normalization against def-lasso-estimator, feature scaling, rank-deficient designs, and the p=1 intercept-only case. Ridge now penalizes lambda||gamma||_2^2, Lasso lambda||gamma||_1, group Lasso slope groups, and fused Lasso lambda_1||gamma||_1+lambda_2||D_0 gamma||_1. No minimizer guarantees were added and no AC is needed. Both page carriers retain compact frontmatter-only inventories. This is the repairer review, not an independent acceptance.

Checked the Gaussian definition and the complete existing multivariate characteristic-function uniqueness proof, together with its scalar uniqueness and Cramer-Wold interfaces. The soft-max Hessian has zero row sums and gives a/4 times the increment-variance difference, so the derivative has the claimed sign. Gaussian coordinate first moments dominate difference quotients on compact t intervals; Fubini now explicitly licenses coordinate integration by parts, with bounded derivatives and vanishing Gaussian boundary terms. The uniform integrable bound on Phi_a(Z_t) gives endpoint continuity, and log(m)/a controls the final maximum limit. No inverse covariance is used, so singular and zero covariance remain allowed. AC covers the suppliers’ inherited choices. The Statement is byte-unchanged; no consumer propagation follows this proof/dependency repair. This is the repairer review, not independent acceptance.
